spec.name: Aisha
spec.archetype: news-driven trader who overreacts to headlines

versions.statement: Aisha frequently struggles to manage her emotions when faced with unexpected news events.
Aisha aims to develop a more structured approach to analyzing news to improve her trading decisions.
Aisha tends to overreact to market headlines, often making impulsive trading decisions.
Aisha prefers trading in markets that are sensitive to news, finding them more exciting and volatile.
Aisha finds it challenging to implement effective risk management practices, particularly after reacting quickly to news.
Aisha prefers using social media platforms as her primary source of news for trading insights.
